hero_title: Find the Right Hospital in Chennai
hero_subtitle: Not just the closest hospital, but the one that truly has available beds, on-duty doctors, essential resources, and manageable crowds.
select_locality_placeholder: Choose your area (e.g. Adyar, Porur, Guindy)...
why_nexcare_desc: During urgent medical needs, going to the closest facility can lead to unexpected delays if it is completely filled or understaffed. NexCare evaluates five practical dimensions:
factor_beds_desc: Real-time ratio of available beds versus occupied beds.
factor_distance_desc: Calculated physical travel distance from your chosen locality.
factor_doctors_desc: Availability of on-duty physicians and specialists across departments.
factor_resources_desc: Status of ICU beds, Oxygen, Lab, Pharmacy, CT scan, and Blood bank.
factor_crowd_desc: Current waiting queue and congestion to minimize wait times.
emergency_box_desc: NexCare is an informational tool only. If a patient requires critical intervention, CPR, or immediate ambulance transport, contact emergency helplines directly:
patient_header_desc: Select your current locality to calculate real travel distances and accurate recommendations.
rec_banner_desc: Rankings balance five factors: Available Beds (30%), Proximity / Distance (20%), Doctors On-Duty (20%), General Resources (15%), and Crowd Queue (15%). This ensures you are directed to facilities that can practically accommodate care right now.
modal_disclaimer: ⚠️ Mandatory Disclaimer: Hospital name and address are real Chennai facilities. All bed numbers, doctor on-duty statuses, and crowd indicators shown are simulated demo figures. Please call the hospital directly to confirm emergency admissions.
